Founded in 2019, Castify.ai leads in the CTV sector, offering innovative solutions for CTV entertainment, monetization and advertising. It enables video content owners to create branded OTT and CTV apps and channels with ease, streamlining distribution across platforms. Castify.ai integrates efficient monetization, ensuring high optimized yields. Positioned as a pioneer in programmatic CTV advertising, it allows content owners to expand their audience while focusing on quality content production.
